excerpt: A dream about me playing Ace Attorney with some unexpected aspects.
title: The Playing Ace Attorney Dream
content:
In this dream, I was playing [[Ace Attorney|Ace Attorney (Series)]] on my [[3DS XL]] on the blue recliner in the living room (shown in the image). The clear table wasn't there, and my dad was standing in place of where it once was while having a conversation with my brother who was beside him (also shown in the image). The only other thing I remember at that point in the dream was [[Phoenix Wright]] had a new sprite that was his hand slamming down on the desk sprite, except only his front hand was slammed down. That part of the dream also took place during the [[post trial wrap-up|Post Trial Wrap-Up]], and in a [[capture card]] like perspective as opposed to my POV like in the first part.

Unlike the end of most Ace Attorney cases, this one ended on a very sombre note, and the only way to make it a little bit less sad was to trade someone an [[Ekans]] for a [[Bellsprout]] (or the other way around, I can’t remember). The final piece of information that I remember is the music during the post trial wrap-up. The music was an instrumental version of the [[Dango theme]], specifically the version from [[Clannad the Motion Picture]], that was remixed to make it sound sad. It also sounded like the start of either the [[SL-9 Incident recollection theme]] or the [[Steel Samurai's Ballad recollection theme]] from Ace Attorney were mixed in there as well.
thoughts: To be honest, this is the like the definition of a generic weird dream. It's not interesting or funny, it just has things in it that are unexplained or strange. It's not good, but it's not bad, and unless a dream is a nightmare, or doesn't really have anything to it, I don't think there will be anything below a 5. That's to say, this dream gets the lowest rating it can get without me actively not liking it. Not bad, not good, just boring relatively speaking to dreams as a whole.

excerpt: A dream where I get chased down by the titular YouTuber.
title: The Binging With Babish Dream
content: In this dream, the guy from the YouTube channel [[Binging With Babish]] was chasing me down the hallway of my grandparents (on my dad's side) house. Once he got me in front of the front door in the dining room, he tased me with a taser made from a battery. After that, my arm that he tased went numb, but it didn't hurt, and then he said something to me along the lines of "didn't hurt did it?"
thoughts: As interesting as this dream may seem, compared to what normal have, it's not that interesting. For me personally, one thing that makes a dream interesting is having a lot of different elements to it, which this one clearly does not. Also, despite the situation, it wasn't scary either, which might have actually made it more interesting. It's still strange, and not something that would happen in real life, but pretty average in terms of dreams.

excerpt: A Clannad related dream that takes place in a classroom.
title: The Clannad School Dream
content:
This dream takes place in my ninth grade science room, except all the desks were facing the other white board (left instead of forward, as shown in the layout image). The teacher was some generic anime teacher with no face, just writing things on the white board. Then another person with no face came to the door of the classroom, and they had two 5-year-old children with them. Both of the children looked like [[Ushio Okazaki]] from [[Clannad]] except they both had [[Dangos|Dango (Clannad)]] for heads. They sat down in seats near the back of the class, and the person who had brought them there left.

I looked two seats to my left (the one directly beside me was empty) and nodded to [[Nagisa Furukawa]] (specifically wearing her Winter outfit) who then proceeded to get up from her seat, take a giant Dango plushie, and place it over the teacher's head. After Nagisa went back to her seat, the now Dango-headed teacher just stood there, and that's how the dream ended.
thoughts: This is a bit of a strange dream. Clannad is my favourite anime of all time, and this is one of the few dreams I've had involving it, so it gets a plus for that. The surreal image of both a person with no face and a person with a Dango for a head are pretty neat, too. That's for having this one, brain!

excerpt: A dream about me going through a black and white town.
title: The Black And White Town Dream
content: In this dream, I was walking around this town that was completely in grey scale, and covered by a mist. I knew I was in a dream, and by extension, knew that I had to die if I wanted to escape, so I tried getting run over by a train. I was still asleep, but I had a health bar, so I tried getting run over by a car next and that woke me up.
thoughts: I had this dream all the way back when I was a kid, so I don't know why I was so intent on leaving the dream, and I can't even remember if I was lucid or not. I do remember the town looking pretty cool, and I liked the vibe of it, in spite of this dream not having much to it.

excerpt: A middle school and anime heavy dream taking place in a gym.
title: The Ram In The School Locker Room Dream
content:
This dream takes place in the gym from my middle school (shown in the layout image). The first thing that happened is that I and some other people did a performance that was very colourful in some way. Apparently there were children on some sort of scaffolding on the stage as well. I was going to distract them to get them down, but I was [[Zoro]] from [[One Piece]] and I wanted to keep that a secret, so to keep that secret I used two swords, and for safety, they were wooden (instead of three real swords).

Apparently, all of the other people who were in the performance were now either fooling around in the gym or trying to clean up somewhere not on the stage. After trying to get the kids down (and succeeding, I think) I went to the location shown in the layout image where my friend Victor was. Victor was holding three of those weird, cheap, metal curtain rods, and I was holding three of them in place of my two wooden swords.

Then [[Ram]] from [[Re:Zero]] appeared, except she was different in a few ways. She was wearing casual clothes, and had the same personality as her sister [[Rem]] (and by "same personality," I mean she was nice and seemed interested in me like how Rem is interested in [[Subaru|Subaru Natsuki]]). Ram said that she was interested in a boy that she mentioned by name in the dream, but it was a name that I never heard before. She said that to try and make me jealous, and then Victor complimented her hair. Then I think I tried to compliment her, but didn’t do it very well, and then Victor complimented her again.

After that, I said that I needed to put my curtain rods in my bag, but Victor offered to take them (take as in keep because I didn’t really want them) and then left after I gave them to him. I needed to go get my bag anyway, and as I was running to the locker room, I turned to Ram while still running and said something like, "your hair looks really nice." Ram then said she needed the washroom, telling me to wait for her. But, I ignored her because I thought to myself that it would still be fine for me to get my bag.

When I got to the locker room area, [[Caden]] was with me, and we both walked into the doorway leading to the locker room. But instead of it being just two doors, it was an airport-esque area. Both me and Caden went to the left where the locker room was, but as soon as we were right in front of it, I realized it was the women's locker room.

For some reason, Caden went inside, but I left and walked over to the left wall where the boys locker room was. When I was almost there, Ram came out from the door and came over to me. She followed me to the locker room area, which was the same as the other one but without the airport part. I accidentally opened the door to the bathroom, and when I turned around to leave, Ram lightly pushed me in and came in with me. She was right in front of me, and as she was pulling me closer, I thought she was going for a kiss, but she was going for a hug. We hugged for a very long time, and while we were hugging, I heard somebody come in. But due to the position of the hug, I couldn’t see them.

As we were still hugging, the dream started to fade into a black screen with a movie ticket on it, with the text on the movie ticket saying something like "the reason why that hug felt so real is because your hand is between your legs." Then I woke up, and sure enough, I was in a position where my hand was between my legs.
thoughts: What makes this dream for me is the ending. The rest is pretty cool too; as cringe as it may be to say, dreams where fictional characters are "real" are pretty cool. But the fact that it ended with a reference to my real life state and having it be true was pretty crazy. I probably have more dreams than the average person since I write them down, which makes me have more dreams, but this is still one of a kind even with that.

excerpt: A dream about someone I knew starting a gambling ring.
title: The Bradley S. Gambling Dream
content: This dream starts at the end of a middle school day. I was outside the school, and had known that a school day had passed. But I couldn’t remember any of it, so I went back inside the school to try and find out what happened. I went to a place that doesn't actually exist in the school; it was a dimly lit hallway with a high ceiling and was really wide. There were police officers roaming around, and once I asked what was going on, one of the officers said that [[Bradley S.]] started an underground gambling ring in the school.
thoughts: This is a fairly normal dream by dream standards, but since I didn't get to see the actual gambling ring, it wasn't that interesting. In fact, the thing that jumps out to me is that I couldn't remember the school day that had happened, and actually acted upon that.

excerpt: A dream about my friend group including Ace Attorney characters.
title: The Ace Attorney Friend Group Dream
content:
This dream starts with me, [[Trucy Wright]], [[Apollo Justice]] and [[Klavier Gavin]] walking through a familiar feeling tunnel. It wasn’t first person; the camera (so to speak) was at the end of the tunnel, with us coming toward it. Apollo and Klavier were wearing casual clothes, and Trucy was wearing a kimono. Trucy and I were walking side by side, while Apollo and Klavier were also walking side by side, just a bit behind and to the left of us.

There was also an alcove in the tunnel, as shown in the layout image. As we all were walking, Trucy stepped on something pointy (for some reason she wasn’t wearing shoes), so me and her went over to the alcove. Also, at this point, it switched to my POV. Apollo and Klavier were just talking while this was happening, and I was trying to see if Trucy was okay (I think). Then my friends [[Pamela]] and [[Vern]] came from the tunnel, and when they did is when I took Trucy back the way we came.
thoughts: Apollo Justice is probably the Ace Attorney game I think about the least, but I really do like the characters, so this was nice. I also had this dream all the way back when I was in middle school, so there's a good chance I was playing it at the time. Still, it's not really that wacky for a dream.

excerpt: I meet the YouTuber Scott the Woz.
title: The Scott The Woz Dream
content: I was walking from [[Lawtons|Lawtons Drugs]] to my home and I met the YouTuber [[Scott the Woz]]. I think I specifically met him when I crossed the cross-walk (shown in the layout image), and maybe walked a little past that part of the way home. Also, although this is obviously a real location, it felt slightly weird. And, although I had this dream before [[The Philosophy Dream]], I would describe it as having similar vibes.
thoughts: There's not much to say about this one. Despite me meeting someone I would be ectatic to meet in real life, it was just treated as normal in the dream. As a result, this gets below the average of 5 on the premise that it's a bad take on something that would be good in real life.

excerpt: I go out with some friends and do strange things.
title: The Weird Outing Dream
content:
I was walking down an unknown street at night, and once I reached the end of it there were two houses, one to my left and one in front of me (like shown in the layout image). The area was covered with Christmas-like lights, and it all looked quite beautiful. I saw my friend [[Nina]] go into the house in front of me, and I was confused because we planned on going somewhere. Then, I saw the YouTuber [[RelaxAlax]] waving off both Nina and [[Pamela]] from the house.

For some reason, Pamela was wearing Nina’s peach-coloured sweater, and Nina was wearing Pamela’s blue sweater. Then, the dream cut to Nina and me at our bus terminal next to our high school, and Nina was inviting me into the elevator to do something. I was hesitant because I didn't want to worry my parents, but I looked at the time (I think on my phone, but I’m not sure) and it said something like 1 in the morning, which meant I would already be worrying them, so I joined her.

The elevator led up to a room which seemed to be a classroom I have never been in before. Me, Pamela, and Nina were near the middle of the room, making some sort of food on a lab-like table. My [[11th grade physics teacher|Mr. Physics 11]] then came in at around 2 AM, and he asked us if we were on our shift. I didn’t know what to say, but then he said "your next shift is at 5:30 right?" We said yes and then he left. We clearly weren’t supposed to be there because he came back to try and catch us, but all that was left was a cartoony sack on the table.
thoughts: I really liked the start of this dream, mostly because of the visual. Obviously, only I know exactly what it looked like, but I'd assume most know what it's like to see a neighbourhood at night during Christmastime. It was something I could easily see in real life given the right time of year, but it was nice to see in a dream, too. I could give or take the rest of the dream, since it was a little weird, but nothing too interesting. I don't have too many dreams that definitely take place during night, so I appreciate this one for that as well.

excerpt: One of my friends turns into Sans Undertale.
title: The Pamela Sans Dream
content: In this dream, I was at my middle school, and I was waiting for my friend [[Pamela]] at the front of the school. She was walking around the school, and when I met up with her, she turned into [[Sans]] from the video game [[Undertale]]. After she turned into Sans, the dream cut to the house from the movie [[The Hate U Give]], where both me and Pamela were playing video games.
thoughts: Although short, my brain did a good job on this one with the strangeness of one of my friends turning into Sans. This dream was also one of it's time, since I was obsessed with Undertale, and specifically Sans at the time, and we had just watched The Hate U Give for school.

excerpt: I run around my elementary school with my brother.
title: The Running At Elementary School Dream
content: This dream starts with my brother and I running around my elementary school. I was running like [[Mario]] when he has his arms outstretched with the [[Super Star]]. Then I went to run to the left, but he told me that was the wrong way. When I went running back around the school, I collected a [[Propeller Box]], which gave me a [[Luigi]] hat with a [[Tanooki Suit]] hat overtop. So I continued running and doing Propeller Box jumps sometimes. When we went to go down the hill, my brother was on his bike and I tripped. I then got back up and ran toward the road overpass.
thoughts: Although I don't think I had this dream during elementary school, I did have this dream a long time ago, and I would probably say middle school era at the soonest, so that's 3 years after elementary school tops. The reason I point this out is that dreams from before I started writing dreams down, especially the older they are, are a bit more interesting to me. It's like a very skewed image of who I was back then, that being very childish, haha. Either way, I really liked the feeling of running around in this dream; it felt so freeing. I would honestly give this dream a higher rating, but I don't like giving out .5 scores on scales of 10, and I don't think it's quite a 7.
